column3: The End Of The Tournament
The day after the tournament.
Akihabara is bustling as ever.
This area is often seen as an "Otaku's Den", but really, it's quite sophisticated.
The public square in front of the station is pretty clean; it makes the place spacious and relaxing.
Saori and Kuroneko have already arrived and are sitting on a bench in the public square.
Oh right, the first time that I met Saori and Kuroneko was in Akihabara as well...
Well then, to celebrate the end of the tournament, to the holy land we came!
Let's go shop around since we're here, alright?
Shopping...
There wouldn't be any atmosphere to it if we were to celebrate immediately. This might be good to raise the tension.
Yeah, alright. Do you guys agree?
It's fine with me.
I don't mind; do what you want.
You heard them, Saori.
I got it! Well then, where should we go first?
Is there any place that you'd recommend?
Every place in Akihabara is recommended... Hmm...
And so Saori pondered for a while.
She's probably searching through the endless "Akiba-data" inside her head.
How about we go to 【Radio Kaikan】 or 【AniMate】?
Kyousuke-shi, do you have any places that you would like to visit?
...*gulp*
It seems simple enough, but in reality, the answer may be of crucial importance.
If I were to choose a place they don't care about, I'm sure that it would turn into some quarrel again.
Hmm... Where should we go?
Also, I shouldn't choose a tiring place...
What do we actually do at Radio Kaikan?
W-What's wrong? W-W-W-What is it?
Radio Kaikan! I want to go to Radio Kaikan!
What's with Radio Kaikan?
Because Radio Kaikan has a figurine shop and there's a special 【Sis×Sis】 booth that started selling limited edition goodies!
Sis×Sis - Sister Sister: Siscon Love Story?
...*sigh*.
I'm getting quite familiar with such topics.
The contents are... that of a bishoujo game.
Because the story is about having a love triangle relationship with your little sisters "Rinko" and "Miyabi", my head hurts.
According to Kirino, it's a "tear-jerking" "godly game". But I frankly don't get it.
However, I do know how to make my own little sister cry...
Stop dilly-dallying! They'll be sold out if we don't hurry up!
They won't be sold out that quickly. Calm down a bit. You'll hurt yourself if you panic.
Sis×Sis is a "godly game"!
Ah, hey! Don't run!
Damn! I want this! This too! And that too!
A-Aren't you buying too much?
Shut it! How I spend my own money is up to me!
This girl, she practically spent all her wages earned as a model, on "Sis×Sis"...
What a big haul! I'm so happy!
Isn't that great, Kiririn-shi.
It isn't that bad to observe humans acting like that every once in a while.
You're still speaking like that～ I can lend them to you if you're interested.
Wha...? Who said such a thing...
Look, look. You want to try them out too, don't you?
Hahaha! Deepening mutual bonds through games! Ah, how wonderful!
Well, she's looking all happy and everything... Oh well.
What do you do in AniMate?
Ohh! As expected of Kyousuke-shi, good choice!
Saori shaped her mouth like that of a cat, and threw her head back.
It seems that today, there's Morimura Kaede-dono doing an autograph session at AniMate!
Seriously?!
This is true, is it?
Who's that?
Not just Kirino, but even the usually expressionless Kuroneko had a reaction... This person must really be something.
Recently, I've been getting more and more familiar with "that genre of topics", but I'm still an amateur after all.
Just hearing the name isn't enough for me to recognize it.
Holy crap! We have to hurry! DASH!
Ah, hey! Don't run!
Oh man... I can't stop shaking.
I can't believe I got to shake hands with Morimura Kaede-san... This isn't a dream, right?
Even for an Akihabara veteran like me, it's been a long time since I got so excited...
It was quite impressive...
Did you see? Kaede-san held my hand gently and winked at me!
Wasn't yours just a normal blink? The one she gave me was a wink.
I've decided! I will never wash my hands!
Uwah... That's such a classic reaction...
Kyousuke-shi, thank you very much for considering my feelings.
Saying that, Saori held out her hands to me. Then...
...Ah, well. It's not like that...
I held out my right hand...
Careful now!!
I held out my left hand and shook hands with Saori...
...By the way, what kind of person is Morimura Kaede?
Kaede-shi is not only a writer, but also a singer, model and star; truly a multi-talented person!
Rumor has it she's participating in a Broadway musical next...
That's amazing, isn't it! I totally admire her!
Oh, I see.
...I don't.
I don't mind where we go....
I see... That's a shame.
Eeeh? We've already come to Akiba, so I wanna go somewhere at least!
That's right, the four of us are together now. Vainly wasting our time goes against the rules of my soul.
You mean you want to have fun, right? You're being way too cryptic.
Would you stop summarizing other people's speeches...?
Hahaha, you two sure get along with each other.
I get exhausted every time I go around Akiba with these girls.
Then what about relaxing in a Maid Cafe?
Oh! That's a good idea!
Huh...?
Ignoring Kirino's lingering glare, we headed for a Maid Cafe.
